Name: Salmon, Son of Nahshon
Summary: Salmon appears in Ruth's genealogy as the son of Nahshon and father of Boaz, in the line from Pharez to David.
KeyStory: Salmon stands in the closing genealogy between Nahshon and Boaz, in the line that runs from Pharez to David.
LifeLesson: Salmon fathered Boaz, who married Ruth — the genealogy's quiet hinge.
